name: refactor
description: Safe refactor: lock behavior with tests, refactor, then verify no behavior changed.

stages.name: baseline
stages.task:
Before any change, add characterization tests that capture the CURRENT behavior of the code in scope, and run them green. Report coverage of the behavior to be preserved.

{task}

stages.name: refactor
stages.task:
Refactor the code in scope for clarity/structure WITHOUT changing behavior. The characterization tests below must keep passing.
{stage.baseline}

stages.name: verify
stages.task:
Re-run the full test suite including the characterization tests. If any behavior changed, say NEEDS_CHANGES with details.
{deps}

stages.name: diffreview
stages.task:
Review the refactor diff: confirm behavior is preserved, the structure is genuinely improved, and no scope crept in.
{deps}
